title: Monday, heavier than usual
difficultMoments: Sprint planning ran two hours over
summary: A heavy Monday: a long sprint planning and a standup that felt like talking to a wall. Maggi at midnight was the only soft part.
journal: I slept badly and the whole day felt like walking through water. Sprint planning went two hours over and nobody really listened in the standup. Rahul texted later to ask if I was okay, which helped a little. I made Maggi at midnight and just sat with it.

title: Chai with Rahul
highlights: Long chai with Rahul after work
Rahul said he's applying to Amazon
thingsToRemember: Rahul is applying for a role at Amazon
summary: A good evening at the Irani café with Rahul, two cutting chais deep, talking about his plan to apply to Amazon.
journal: Work was busy but fine. After, Rahul and I went to the Irani café and had cutting chai and bun maska. He told me he's applying to Amazon and I could tell he was nervous about saying it out loud. It felt good to just sit and talk without checking my phone.

title: Leaving for Bhopal
highlights: Caught the train with five minutes to spare
summary: A frantic morning of packing gave way to a slow, happy train ride towards Bhopal and home.
journal: I packed in a total panic and made the train with five minutes to spare. Once it started moving everything slowed down. I had poha and a samosa from the vendor and called Mom to say I was on my way. I'm excited to be home for a bit.

title: Upper Lake with Mom
highlights: Evening walk by Upper Lake with Mom
thingsToRemember: Mom wants to visit in December
summary: The best kind of slow day in Bhopal: poha jalebi in the morning and a long sunset walk by Upper Lake with Mom.
journal: I slept nine hours in my old room. Mom made aloo paratha and we got poha jalebi from the corner shop anyway. In the evening we walked along Upper Lake and talked about nothing and everything. Papa told the same jokes at dinner and I laughed every time. Mom wants to visit me in December.

title: The train back
highlights: Mom packed theplas for the train
summary: A bittersweet goodbye at Bhopal station and a long ride back with Mom's theplas.
journal: Saying bye at the station was harder than I expected. Mom packed theplas and I ate them slowly to make them last. I had a mild headache by the time I got back and went straight to sleep.

title: The release that slipped
difficultMoments: Got blamed for the release delay that wasn't my part
summary: A rough day: the release slipped and the blame landed in the wrong place. Skipped lunch, carried it in the shoulders.
journal: The release slipped and in the meeting it somehow became my fault, even though the delay was on the backend side. I didn't say anything, I just sat there. I skipped lunch and my shoulders were tight all evening. I didn't want advice, I just wanted someone to know.

title: Saturday, unplugged
highlights: Pani puri with Aditi at the market
summary: A slow, unplugged Saturday with pancakes, a nap, and pani puri at the market with Aditi.
journal: I didn't open my laptop all day. I made pancakes, took a long nap, and met Aditi at the market for pani puri in the evening. We laughed about the most random things.

title: Sunday at home
thingsToRemember: Aditi wants the banana bread recipe
summary: A warm Sunday at home: rajma chawal, a long call with Mom, and banana bread with Aditi.
journal: Filter coffee in the morning and rajma chawal for lunch. I had a long video call with Mom. In the evening Aditi came over and we baked banana bread that came out better than it had any right to.

title: Too many tabs open
difficultMoments: Couldn't focus on anything for long
summary: A scattered, restless day where nothing quite held still, ending awake until two.
journal: My head felt like a browser with fifty tabs open. I kept starting things and not finishing them. Dal rice for dinner, and then I couldn't sleep until two.

title: First pottery class
highlights: The first bowl finally held its shape
difficultMoments: Three bowls collapsed on the wheel
summary: A mixed day: three collapsed bowls at the first pottery class, then one that finally held its shape.
journal: I went to my first pottery class with Aditi. Three bowls collapsed on the wheel and I wanted to give up. Then the fourth one held, lopsided but standing, and I couldn't stop smiling. Next class is Thursday.

title: Rahul's good news
thingsToRemember: Rahul's Amazon interview is on Tuesday
summary: A bright day: a focused morning, then Rahul called with news of his Amazon interview and they celebrated with biryani.
journal: I got a lot done in the morning. Then Rahul called, he got the interview at Amazon! It's on Tuesday. We ordered biryani to celebrate and walked down the lake road after. I'm so happy for him.
